text: an old refrigerator compressor humming, then clicking off into silence, quiet kitchen room tone
a smartphone emergency alert tone, harsh two-tone beeps, then vibration on a wooden table
kitchen tap running into a plastic bottle, the pitch rising as it fills
bathtub tap running fast into a half-full tub, echoing small bathroom
food cans and jars set down one by one on a wooden table
a pencil writing quickly on notebook paper, close
turning the dial of an old portable radio through static and whistles, landing on a station
a table lamp switch clicking off in a quiet room
quiet apartment at night, distant city, a faint hum, no voices
ONE single clean knock of a knuckle on a metal radiator pipe, close, dry
an old wall intercom crackling on, a short buzz and a click
a fingertip writing on a fogged glass window, squeaking
a sheet of paper slapped onto a wall and taped down, four tape tears
a heavy rubber stamp slammed on paper on a wall
air moving through a metal duct at night, a low hollow whisper of wind
slow heavy rubber boots walking down a tiled hospital corridor, squeaking, getting closer
a failing fluorescent emergency light buzzing and flickering
